para.emphasis: This option is experimental for now!

description.para: This option controls whether winbindd tries to use S4U2SELF impersonation for composing the user groupmembership token. Note currently this only applies to the primary domain

The behavior can be controlled per netbios domain by using 'winbind use s4u2self:NETBIOSDOMAIN = yes|no' as option. This can be used in order to activate it also for trusted domains, but this is hits problems depending on the krb5 library, e.g. currently heimdal only supports the primary domain or firewalls may block krb5 to DC or other domains.
